subject.title: feat: add jsonl support to memory indexer

question: Should arbitrary JSONL logs become a first-class builtin memory input, or should structured message history remain on sanitized session-memory, QMD, or converter/plugin paths?
rationale: Current code deliberately separates generic document files from shaped session records, and changing that boundary affects privacy, visibility, persistence, and core ownership.

options.title: Preserve sanitized boundaries
options.body: Document session search, session-memory, QMD, or converter/plugin workflows and keep generic extra paths document-oriented.

options.title: Approve bounded JSONL
options.body: Define the safe record and lifecycle contract, then implement it across discovery, indexing, retrieval, watching, documentation, and tests.

recommendation.title: Preserve sanitized boundaries
recommendation.body: Document session search, session-memory, QMD, or converter/plugin workflows and keep generic extra paths document-oriented.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest relevant current-main history and already participated in the issue's memory-boundary discussion.
